versions.content: Storage of Persistent Data Description: Persistency shall support persistent storage of data of an Adaptive Application or of another Functional Cluster. Additional Information: There are different possibilities for an implementation of Persistency to store data. Persistency could use a file system, in which case it does not have full control over the actual storage on the physical device. Alternatively, it could use a physical device directly, in which case it might have to take care of wear leveling, because these devices have a limited number of write cycles, and some devices don’t feature wear leveling in hardware. Rationale: Applications need to preserve data from one run-time to the next. This data could be settings, diagnostic data, calibration data, or error logs.
